title: Simplified Workflow Language
description: Compact JSON form for authoring workflows. Compiled into the full Workflow DSL by scripts/compile.py.

description.description: Optional one-line description of what the workflow produces.

prompt.description: The user-facing prompt that kicks off the workflow.

documents.description: Optional list of documents to pass in at start. Each item is either a path string OR a full document object as produced by the editor's upload step (id, name, path, mimeType, etc.). Pass-through to the DSL — the compiler does not normalize.

flow.description: Directed edges between nodes. Reserved ids 'start' and 'output' bracket the graph.

id.description: Local identifier referenced by flow edges. Must not be 'start' or 'output'.

name.description: Display name shown in the editor.

description.description: Short description of what the agent does.

model.description: Optional provider-specific model id. Empty string lets the engine pick the default.

tools.description: MCP tool names the agent can call.

instructions.description: System prompt — role, persona, scope, hard constraints.

skill.description: Optional procedure / output-format guidance. Maps to DSL field skill_content.

agent_template_id.description: Optional template id from the agent registry to bind to.

output_schema_id.description: Optional reference to a structured-output schema.

skill_binding.description: Optional binding to a folder-backed skill (e.g. 'medium-format', 'html', 'docx'). String form is just the skill's dir_name; the compiler expands it to {id, name, source: 'local', dir_name}. Use the object form when you need a non-local source. Different from 'skill' (inline procedure text).
